prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: wide architectural concept illustration for a high-density academic PowerPoint slide, two matched office configurations shown side by side.
Primary request: Show the same compact rectangular office in two identical isometric cutaway views, with the ONLY difference being the mounting location of one wall-mounted split air conditioner. These are configuration concepts, not results.
Scene: one 6 by 4 by 2.8 metre rectangular office, exactly FOUR desks with computers and FOUR chairs in a stable 2 by 2 arrangement. Pale neutral walls, grey floor, one wide window on the left wall, an entry doorway on the far wall, no people. Two walls removed or very low to reveal all four chairs and desk positions clearly. Keep the furniture, window, door, room proportions, camera, scale and lighting identical in both panels.
Configuration left: one split AC on the LEFT SIDE WALL near the room's mid-length, at high mounting level. Configuration right: remove that unit from the side wall and put exactly ONE identical split AC near the centre of the REAR WALL. Make both AC units subtly accented in teal so the moved unit is easy to see. The left-wall window remains the same in both configurations and does not overlap the AC unit.
Style: precise, elegant architectural study model, white and pale grey surfaces with understated cyan/teal accents (#277F89 and #57BCC7). Fine crisp edges, gentle ambient occlusion, restrained soft shadows. Match an academic Mac-first product pitch deck.
Composition: very wide approximately 2.2:1 horizontal image. Two complete room models side by side, equal size, placed close enough to compare but with clear white gutter. Show each model from exactly the same raised front-right isometric view. Models fill the frame with minimal outer white margin. Pure white backdrop that blends into a white slide. Room floor footprint and all chairs fully visible.
Text: none. No embedded letters, numbers, headings, labels, logos or watermark. We will add editable labels in PowerPoint.
Constraints: geometric configuration illustration ONLY. No airflow lines, no colour field, no heat map, no temperature readings, no CFD mesh, no claimed comfort or efficiency change. No red/green success coding. Exactly four desks and four chairs in each view. Do not add a second AC to either view.
scope: Hypothetical geometric office configurations. Not measured or simulated performance.
